pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers its boundary itself (OREG: every PHY command output from a flop; KREG: K request in a 2-entry pin skid, k_rdy from a register; KRREG: K response from a 2-entry skid; RREG: PHY return valid+data captured at the pin; pc_id/refresh_reload straps captured in pc_id_q/refresh_reload_q).
